skill.summary: Plan campaign visuals and hooks for finance promotions. Use when working on paid campaign planning for finance teams, analysts, operators.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of "Generate Finance Ad Creative Brief" skill.

- Enables planning of visuals and hooks for finance promotional campaigns.
- Designed for finance teams, analysts, and operators working on paid campaign planning.
- Step-by-step workflow included for clarifying goals and refining creative briefs.
- Integrates with chat and image generation APIs.
- Optimized for finance ad planning and automation-related search queries.
